complement each other: Her calm personality and his endless energy complement each other perfectly, which is why they make such a good team.
她沉穩的個性和他無窮的活力完美互補，這就是他們如此合作無間的原因。
complement the dish: The chef suggested a glass of white wine to complement the dish, because its light taste goes well with fish.
主廚建議搭配一杯白酒為菜餚增色，因為它清爽的口感很適合魚。
complement one's skills: The young engineer hired a partner with marketing experience to complement his skills and help the business grow.
那位年輕工程師聘請了一位有行銷經驗的夥伴來補足他的技能，幫助事業成長。
compliment someone on: Several guests stopped to compliment her on the delicious cake she had baked for the party.
好幾位客人停下來稱讚她為派對烤的美味蛋糕。
pay a compliment: It is a good habit to pay a compliment to a classmate who has worked hard, because kind words build confidence.
向努力的同學給予讚美是個好習慣，因為好話能建立自信。
fish for compliments: When she kept asking whether her new haircut looked ugly, we knew she was just trying to fish for compliments.
她一直問新髮型是不是很醜時，我們就知道她只是在討讚美。
comply with the rules: All visitors to the laboratory must comply with the rules and wear safety glasses at all times.
所有實驗室的訪客都必須遵守規定，隨時配戴護目鏡。
comply with a request: The hotel staff tried their best to comply with a request from a guest who wanted a quieter room.
飯店員工盡力依照一位想要更安靜房間的客人的要求處理。
fail to comply: Restaurants that fail to comply with the new health law will have to pay a heavy fine.
未遵守新衛生法規的餐廳將必須繳交高額罰款。
compose music: Mozart began to compose music when he was only five years old, and he wrote hundreds of pieces in his short life.
莫札特年僅五歲就開始作曲，並在短暫的一生中寫下數百首作品。
compose oneself: Before walking onto the stage, she took a few deep breaths to compose herself and stop her hands from shaking.
走上舞台前，她深呼吸幾次讓自己鎮定下來，不再雙手發抖。
be composed of: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen, two gases that combine to form the liquid we drink every day.
水由氫和氧組成，這兩種氣體結合成我們每天喝的液體。
compose a letter: It took him over an hour to compose a letter of apology to his neighbor because every word mattered.
他花了一個多小時寫信向鄰居道歉，因為每個字都很重要。
compound the problem: Shouting at the angry customer will only compound the problem, so stay calm and listen to his complaint.
對生氣的顧客大吼只會使問題惡化，所以要保持冷靜，聽他抱怨。
compounded by bad weather: The traffic delays were compounded by bad weather, turning a one-hour drive into a three-hour nightmare.
交通延誤加上壞天氣更糟，讓一小時的車程變成三小時的噩夢。
compound interest: Thanks to compound interest, the money you save when you are young can grow much larger by the time you retire.
多虧複利，你年輕時存下的錢到退休時能成長得多很多。
compress a file: The video was too large to send by email, so I had to compress a file before sending it.
影片太大無法用電子郵件寄出，所以我必須先壓縮檔案再寄。
compress the schedule: Because the client moved the deadline forward, we had to compress the schedule and finish in two weeks.
因為客戶把截止日期提前，我們必須壓縮時程，在兩週內完成。
compress ideas into a paragraph: For the exam, students must learn to compress ideas into a paragraph of no more than eighty words.
為了考試，學生必須學會把想法濃縮成一段不超過八十字的段落。
comprise five members: The new student council will comprise five members, each chosen by a different grade.
新的學生會將由五人組成，每位成員由不同年級選出。
be comprised of: The basketball team is comprised of players from six different countries, so they speak English during practice.
這支籃球隊由來自六個不同國家的球員組成，所以他們練習時講英文。
comprise 20% of sales: Online orders now comprise 20% of sales at the bookstore, while the rest still come from customers in the shop.
網路訂單現在占這家書店銷售兩成，其餘仍來自店內顧客。
compromise on price: The seller refused to compromise on price, so we left the market without buying the antique table.
賣家不肯在價格上讓步，所以我們沒買那張古董桌就離開了市場。
compromise one's principles: The honest judge refused to compromise his principles, even though accepting the bribe would have made him rich.
那位正直的法官拒絕犧牲原則，即使收下賄賂會讓他致富。
compromise safety: Airlines should never compromise safety just to save money on repairs and fuel.
航空公司絕不應為了省下維修和燃料的錢而危及安全。
a compromised system: After hackers broke in, the bank shut down a compromised system to stop more customer data from being stolen.
駭客入侵後，銀行關閉了一個遭入侵的系統，以防更多客戶資料被竊。
reach a compromise: After hours of arguing, the two sides finally managed to reach a compromise that both of them could accept.
爭論了好幾個小時後，雙方終於達成一個彼此都能接受的妥協。
conceal the truth: The company tried to conceal the truth about the dangerous chemicals, but a former worker told the newspapers everything.
公司試圖隱瞞有關危險化學物質的真相，但一名前員工把一切都告訴了報社。
conceal one's feelings: She smiled to conceal her feelings of disappointment, so nobody at the party knew how upset she really was.
她微笑著掩飾失望的情感，所以派對上沒有人知道她其實有多難過。
conceal a weapon: At the airport, security officers check every bag to make sure no passenger tries to conceal a weapon.
在機場，安檢人員檢查每個包包，確保沒有乘客試圖藏武器。
conceal evidence: The suspect was arrested again after he tried to conceal evidence by burning his clothes in the backyard.
那名嫌犯企圖在後院燒掉衣服來隱匿證據，因而再度被捕。
